$schema: known CommonMark 0.31.2 deviations; this list may shrink, never grow
description: Every entry is proven by tests/commonmark.test.ts, not merely asserted: each cause has a verification test that re-renders the example and shows the stated cause fully accounts for the difference. Adding an entry without a passing verification does not make the suite green.

htmlByDesign.criterion: compileMarkdown(source) produces at least one raw `html` mdast node. The content policy (RENDER-08) never turns raw HTML into markup — it renders it as visible escaped text, or removes it under skipHtml — so these examples cannot match the spec HTML without an explicit rehype-raw + rehype-sanitize opt-in. Not defects.

causes.react-resource-preload: A React 19 static-rendering artifact shared by every React markdown renderer, including react-markdown 10.1.0. Verified by re-comparing with the hoisted <link rel=preload> floats removed.
causes.url-policy: The default urlTransform (RENDER-08) blanks URLs whose scheme is not http/https/mailto/xmpp/irc/ircs. Verified by re-rendering the example with an identity urlTransform.

500.reason: link destination `foo):` parses as scheme `foo)`, which the default URL policy blanks
